description: This file defines a Java class RmiServiceEngine that extends a generic asynchronous engine for executing remote services via RMI (Remote Method Invocation). It handles service execution, including lookup and error handling, for remote dispatchers in the context of the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: RmiServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that provides RMI-based implementation for service execution within the OFBiz framework, extending the generic async engine.

methods.name: RmiServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine with a service dispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously by invoking the run method.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs the service asynchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Core method that performs RMI lookup to a remote dispatcher and invokes the service, handling exceptions appropriately.
